title: 1.5 Brothers, Sisters, and Adults
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Say who is a brother, a sister, or an adult, in the singular and the plural, with ellas for women and girls.
grammar_function: Él/Ella es un/una + noun; Ellos/Ellas son + plural noun; los/las + plural noun.
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.4: people, articles, es/está, son/están, and plurals.
speaking_outcome: Say who is a brother, a sister, or an adult.

cards.pedagogy_note: adulto takes un (English needs an; Spanish does not).
Plural: los adultos (men and women together).
